name: comb-pdf-form-filling
title_zh: 一格一字，把 IBAN 税号填进德国官方表格的方框里
tagline_zh: 德国官方表格的方框最怕字跑偏：IBAN、税号、BIC、邮编、日期，一格一字，打印出来正好落在格子里。
tagline_en: German official forms hate drifting text: IBAN, tax ID, BIC, postcode, dates — one glyph per box, printed exactly.
desc_en: Use when filling an official PDF form to print, sign or submit, and each character has to land inside its own printed box (a comb field) - IBAN, tax number, BIC, postcode, dates. Covers German Behörden-, Steuer- and Bank-Vordrucke (SEPA-Lastschriftmandat, Finanzamt and insurer forms) and any AcroForm or flat PDF with printed boxes. Triggers on comb field, Kästchen, one letter per box, Vordruck, Fo
why_zh: 它按每个方框的坐标单独放字，不是整段文本硬塞；AcroForm 和纯图片 PDF 都认。
why_en: It places each glyph by its own box coordinates instead of dumping a text run, so AcroForm and flat PDFs both land correctly.
limit_zh: 只处理有印刷方框的表格；没有 comb 字段的普通 PDF 它不接管。扫描件若没文字层，得先自己 OCR 出坐标。
limit_en: Only forms with printed boxes; plain PDFs without comb fields are out of scope. Scans without a text layer need OCR first, or it stops and asks.
title_en: One glyph per box: fill German official PDF forms correctly
